components.description: Main MCU. GPIO0–15 asynchronous 8-bit FPGA link; native 4-bit SD; C5 SPI1/UART0; GPIO47 QMI CS1. All 81 physical package terminals included.
RP2350 native buck inductor. Preserve Raspberry Pi R4-S1 placement and marked winding orientation; do not substitute an unmarked inductor.
Native buck input bypass directly at U201 pin64; copied R4-S1 C6.
Native buck output capacitor at inductor/U201 feedback; copied R4-S1 C7.
Additional DVDD bulk decoupling; copied R4-S1 C9.
Native regulator analog supply filter, copied R4-S1 R3.
VREG_AVDD pin61 bypass after 33-ohm filter.
U201 pin5 IOVDD local bypass; placement reference is Raspberry Pi minimal PCB.
U201 pin10 DVDD local bypass; placement reference is Raspberry Pi minimal PCB.
U201 pin15 IOVDD local bypass; placement reference is Raspberry Pi minimal PCB.
U201 pin24 IOVDD local bypass; placement reference is Raspberry Pi minimal PCB.

U201 pin60 IOVDD local bypass; placement reference is Raspberry Pi minimal PCB.

U201 pin69 QSPI_IOVDD local bypass; placement reference is Raspberry Pi minimal PCB.
U201 pin76 IOVDD local bypass; placement reference is Raspberry Pi minimal PCB.
Controller local bulk bypass.
Official RP crystal recommendation: 12MHz, CL10pF; both case pins grounded.
Crystal damping resistor, official 3.3V reference.
Crystal input load capacitor C0G.
Crystal output load capacitor C0G.
QSPI clock source termination/tuning footprint; populate 0ohm initially.
Boot flash chip select link; pull-up and BOOTSEL resistor close to flash.
Boot flash chip-select pull-up.
BOOTSEL ground request through 1k, prevents output contention after boot.
GPIO47 QMI CS1 link.
PSRAM CS high at reset despite RP GPIO default pull-down; stronger than 10k for APS high threshold.
Official minimal-reference boot flash, SOIC-8 208mil SI package. Firmware image and configuration; not raw-SD cache.
Boot flash pin8 local bypass.
8MiB volatile cache, 3.3V USON-8 ZR; height max0.50mm. Separate GPIO47 CS1 shares QSPI clock/data with boot flash. No fictitious center electrical pin.
PSRAM VDD low-ESR bypass required by AP Memory section16.4.
PSRAM additional high-frequency bypass.
SD CLK series damping/tuning footprint; validate clock edges on installed board.
SD CMD series damping/tuning footprint; validate clock edges on installed board.
Native SD CMD pull-up on card-side storage rail.
SD DAT0 series damping/tuning footprint; validate clock edges on installed board.
Native SD DAT0 pull-up on card-side storage rail.
SD DAT1 series damping/tuning footprint; validate clock edges on installed board.
Native SD DAT1 pull-up on card-side storage rail.
SD DAT2 series damping/tuning footprint; validate clock edges on installed board.
Native SD DAT2 pull-up on card-side storage rail.
SD DAT3 series damping/tuning footprint; validate clock edges on installed board.
Native SD DAT3 pull-up on card-side storage rail.

Native 4-bit microSD socket. Pins1–8 exactly follow Molex drawing. Detect pads9/10 and four shared-number SH shell lands follow verified KiCad footprint plus Molex drawing;14 physical lands total. Detect closes on insertion.
Detect contact pull-up; grounded when card is inserted.
SD socket high-frequency bypass.
SD socket bulk bypass.
Two fixed-direction pairs: pair1 A-to-B, pair2 B-to-A. Outputs high-impedance when either supply<100mV; Ioff specified. OE defaults high until RP firmware enables after module rail stable.
U204 VCCA bypass.
U204 VCCB bypass.
Two fixed-direction pairs: pair1 A-to-B, pair2 B-to-A. Outputs high-impedance when either supply<100mV; Ioff specified. OE defaults high until RP firmware enables after module rail stable.
U205 VCCA bypass.
U205 VCCB bypass.
All4 DAT channels reverse together. DIR high=MCU-to-card; low=card-to-MCU. OE high isolates during reset, storage brownout or firmware stop. Both rails need valid supplies for transfer.

CLK fixed MCU-to-card; CMD direction high=MCU-to-card, low=card-to-MCU. Unused bidirectional lane tied low at both ends so either direction has a defined input; unused fixed-direction output explicitly NC.
U207 VCCA local bypass.
U207 VCCB local bypass.
U208 VCCA local bypass.
U208 VCCB local bypass.
SD data default receive direction; OE separately disables all channels.
SD CMD default receive direction; OE separately disables all channels.
SD driver request default off during RP reset.
SD isolation OE default high during logic startup.

Hardware NAND: SD outputs enable only when both firmware request and storage rail valid. STORAGE_PGOOD must go low before card supply drops below2.7V; power block supplies this signal. LVC1G00 Ioff prevents gate back-power when logic rail is off.
U209 NAND local bypass.
Storage power-good input safe low if monitor absent/unpowered.
Default disable for all C5 SPI/UART/handshake buffers; MCU GPIO20 drives low only after stable rails.
RP-side CS idle high before C5 buffers enabled.
Module-side SPI CS idle high while isolated.
Module UART RX idle high while isolated.
Module-side idle-low bias while buffers are disabled.
Module-side idle-low bias while buffers are disabled.
RP input defined low when C5 is removed/off/isolated.
RP input defined low when C5 is removed/off/isolated.
RP input defined low when C5 is removed/off/isolated.
RP UART RX idle-high bias when C5 is isolated.

Complete Seeed module, USB connector removed, no pin headers/battery. 14 numbered edge pads plus actual named underside/battery pads; carrier only contacts edge pads and TP2/TP8. Other underside pads deliberately unconnected. Removable Harwin S7221-45R contacts carry the physical PCB interface. Module is manual off-board assembly with no duplicated carrier copper footprint.
C5 carrier switched5V bulk bypass; module contains its own regulator and bypass.
Open-drain sink to actual C5 underside recovery testpad. Host3V3 cannot feed module through this path. On-module10k pull-up retained.
Recovery sink defaults off during MCU reset.
Open-drain sink to actual C5 underside recovery testpad. Host3V3 cannot feed module through this path. On-module10k pull-up retained.
Recovery sink defaults off during MCU reset.
USB D- series resistor immediately at RP2350 pin66.
USB D+ series resistor immediately at RP2350 pin67.
USB VBUS sense divider upper resistor; no power connection to console5V.
USB VBUS sense divider lower resistor;5V becomes2.5V.
RP RUN/reset pull-up; service probe can sink reset.
Four copper service contacts for external USB cable/jig. VBUS only feeds sense divider; bridge must be powered from console/bench5V. Native BOOTSEL USB firmware recovery with crystal.
Six copper service contacts, no populated header. VTREF is reference output only; ground BOOTSEL request then pulse RUN low to enter RP ROM USB mode.

Direct3.3V UART jig pads on module side of isolation, usable with RP buffers disabled. VTREF is sense only. Pull BOOT low, pulse EN low, release EN, keep bootstrap for>=3ms. No5V UART and no power output from programmer.
C5 switched5V enable default off; actual switch belongs to power block.

firmware_requirements: SD via PIO in native4-bit mode, not SPI;GPIO24 DAT direction,25 CMD direction,26 active-high enable request;SD_IO_OEn hardware=NAND(request,STORAGE_PGOOD)
C5 SPI2 GPIO-matrix configuration must match module mapping
RP C5 isolation OE remains high until powered/stable and before removal or5V switch-off
ROM C5 UART recovery proxy and SPI application update path require implementation; circuit does not by itself provide updates
USB only attaches after USB_SERVICE_VBUS sense high; do not connect host5V to console rails
Hardware SD isolation uses STORAGE_PGOOD; keep storage rail alive for flush; coordinate PIO direction and OE at CMD/DAT turnaround
PSRAM QMI CS1 select=GPIO47; initialize>=150us after supply stable,split transfers to meet AP tCEM(max)8us and deselect>=tCPH
FPGA/front-end owns safe default reset, arm and link-strobe pull resistors
FPGA transfer engine exact24-bit remaining-word count registers0x16/17/18 must be set before DRQ; transfer-done IRQ distinguishes command completion from temporary FIFO empty
